```{python}
from pathlib import Path

from branca.element import Element
import folium
import geopandas as gpd
```

```{python}
DATA_PATH = Path('data/building_with _inference.geojson')
DAMAGE_FIELD = 'predicted_class'

buildings = gpd.read_file(DATA_PATH)
if buildings.crs is None:
    buildings = buildings.set_crs('EPSG:4326')
buildings = buildings.to_crs('EPSG:4326')

status = buildings[DAMAGE_FIELD].astype('string').str.strip().str.lower()
scored = buildings.loc[status.isin(['damaged', 'undamaged'])].copy()
scored['prediction'] = status.loc[scored.index]
scored['confidence_pct'] = (100 * scored['confidence']).round(1).astype('string') + '%'
scored['prob_damaged_pct'] = (100 * scored['prob_damaged']).round(1).astype('string') + '%'

damaged_count = int(scored['prediction'].eq('damaged').sum())
undamaged_count = int(scored['prediction'].eq('undamaged').sum())
total_count = len(scored)

map_center = (47.6588, -117.4260)

m = folium.Map(
    location=map_center,
    zoom_start=10,
    tiles=None,
    control_scale=True,
    prefer_canvas=True,
)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    attr='Tiles &copy; Esri',
    name='Esri World Street Map',
    control=True,
).add_to(m)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    attr='Tiles &copy; Esri',
    name='Esri World Imagery',
    control=True,
    show=False,
).add_to(m)


def footprint_style(feature):
    prediction = feature['properties'].get('prediction')
    damaged = prediction == 'damaged'
    return {
        'color': '#9e1215' if damaged else '#1f5f8b',
        'fillColor': '#d7191c' if damaged else '#2c7bb6',
        'fillOpacity': 0.34 if damaged else 0.2,
        'opacity': 0.85,
        'weight': 0.8,
    }


def footprint_highlight(_feature):
    return {
        'fillOpacity': 0.58,
        'weight': 1.8,
    }


popup_fields = [
    'prediction',
    'confidence_pct',
    'prob_damaged_pct',
    'image_path',
    'id',
]

folium.GeoJson(
    scored[
        [
            'id',
            'image_path',
            'prediction',
            'confidence_pct',
            'prob_damaged_pct',
            'geometry',
        ]
    ],
    name='Building footprints',
    show=True,
    style_function=footprint_style,
    highlight_function=footprint_highlight,
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=['prediction', 'prob_damaged_pct'],
        aliases=['Prediction', 'Damage probability'],
        sticky=False,
    ),
    popup=folium.GeoJsonPopup(
        fields=popup_fields,
        aliases=[
            'Prediction',
            'Confidence',
            'Damage probability',
            'Image',
            'ID',
        ],
        labels=True,
        max_width=360,
    ),
).add_to(m)

bounds = scored.total_bounds
m.fit_bounds(
    [
        [bounds[1], bounds[0]],
        [bounds[3], bounds[2]],
    ],
    padding=(28, 28),
    max_zoom=14,
)

legend_html = '''
<div class='footprint-legend'>
  <div><span class='legend-dot damaged'></span>Damaged</div>
  <div><span class='legend-dot undamaged'></span>Undamaged</div>
</div>
'''

m.get_root().html.add_child(Element(legend_html))

folium.LayerControl(collapsed=False).add_to(m)

m
```
